description: Split up the React code from /experiment/index route into separate sensible sub-routes.
steps: Create a new route file for each sub-route in ./routes/experiment directory.
Move the React code from /experiment/index route into the new sub-routes.
Update the /experiment/index route to use the new sub-routes.
Update the navigation to use the new sub-routes.
Update the URL structure to use the new sub-routes.

description: Use the 'session' Zustand store for any state that needs to be shared between routes.
steps: If needed, add additional slices to the 'session' Zustand store.
Update all current usages of 'useGlobalStore' to use 'useSessionStore' instead.
Make sure that all state is read and write only through reactive hooks, not through '.getState()' or '.setState()'.
Remove the 'useGlobalStore' hook from any files that are no longer needed.

description: Split up the React code in the experiments routes into more sub-components
steps: Extract self-sustained components from experiments into src/components.
Make sure the components are independent of state and only rely on their props.
